answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 23 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in plume, queued in lantern, and canyon publishes the wait time. A farm of 247 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 2248 identities would post 3391 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
